title: Algebraic Spectral Curves of Two-Channel Operator Pencils with Power-Law Response
summary: A finite matrix can acquire a nontrivial algebraic spectral curve when its entries contain a multivalued response. We study this mechanism for a two-channel pencil with scalar response $z^β$ and $J$-self-adjoint matrices. If $β=r/n$ is in lowest terms and the coefficients are generic, the normalized determinant curve in $(z,λ)$ has genus $n-1$ and is a double cover. It is rational for $n=1$, elliptic for $n=2$, and hyperelliptic for $n\geq3$. The generic genus depends only on the denominator $n$.
